meta.title: Hotel Management System | Room Booking & Cloud PMS | DigIT-Hack
meta.description: Complete hotel management software for room booking, check-in, housekeeping, accounts and channel manager. Built for modern hotels and resorts.

hero.headline: Smart Hotel Management Software
hero.subLine: Complete cloud-based system to manage room bookings, check-ins, staff, housekeeping and hotel operations from one dashboard.

blocks.title: Complete Hotel Management Solution
blocks.content: Designed for hotels, lodges and resorts, our system helps manage room bookings, guest check-ins, housekeeping, billing and reports in one secure cloud platform. Monitor your hotel operations in real time and deliver a smooth guest experience.

items.title: Full Cloud Setup
items.description: Access your hotel system from anywhere with secure cloud-based management.

items.title: Check-in / Check-out
items.description: Fast guest check-in and check-out with face photo capture and digital records.

items.title: Live Room Status
items.description: Booking tray with real-time room availability and occupancy status.

items.title: Advance Booking
items.description: Manage future reservations, walk-ins and online bookings easily.

blocks.title: Housekeeping & Operations
blocks.content: Track room cleaning status, assign housekeeping tasks and ensure rooms are always ready for guests. Improve efficiency and maintain service quality with real-time updates.

items.title: Staff Management
items.description: Manage staff roles, shifts, salaries and performance easily.

items.title: Accounts
items.description: Track income, expenses and financial reports for complete hotel accounting.

items.title: Inventory Management
items.description: Monitor hotel inventory like linens, room items and supplies.

items.title: Channel Manager
items.description: Sync room availability and pricing across booking platforms automatically.

items.title: Booking Engine
items.description: Allow direct room bookings from your website with real-time availability.

items.title: Restaurant POS Integration
items.description: Integrated restaurant billing for in-house guests and room service.

items.title: Banquet Module
items.description: Manage events, hall bookings and catering services easily.

blocks.title: Ready to Simplify Your Hotel Management?
blocks.content: DigIT-Hack hotel management software is fully customizable for your property workflow. Whether you run a small lodge or a large hotel, manage bookings, rooms, staff, and reports from one powerful system.
